{{Quote|What a desolate place this is.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="SWE4" />}}
The '''Dune Sea''', also known as the '''Great Sea''', was a vast, sandy [[Desert/Legends|desert]] that stretched across the surface of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In the [[Tatooine navigation system]], it was located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] first quadrant.

==History==
{{Quote|Mr. Kenobi told us stories about living out on the Dune Sea... It was great!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]|<ref name="Luke Skywalker's Walkabout">{{StoryCite|story=Luke Skywalker's Walkabout|book=Dark Horse Presents Annual 1999: DHP Jr.}}</ref>}}
[[File:Bantha_skeleton.png|thumb|left|250px|A [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] skeleton bakes on the Dune Sea under the twin suns.]]


[[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|Thousands of years]] before the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Tatooine used to be a lush world of [[Forest/Legends|forest]] and [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]<nowiki/>s, where the vast sand dune would have likely been covered entirely in [[Water/Legends|water]]. And therefore, as an actual sea, it may have simply been called '''The Sea'''.

The Dune Sea on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was once the bed of an inland sea. In the [[Tatooine navigation system]], it was located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] first quadrant.

Extreme [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] and lack of [[Water/Legends|water]] made the area inhospitable to most lifeforms. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] could dehydrate after about thirty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] from overexposure.<ref name="SWJ">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>

During the time of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Star Map|star temple]] was built in a cave in the [[Eastern Dune Sea]]. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his companions found the map being guarded by a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] and used its information to discover [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

[[File:Bantha_herd.png|thumb|left|250px|A herd of Banthas crossing the Dune Sea]]
[[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] was located just beyond the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|southwestern border]] of this desert.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi junior novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novel]]</ref><ref name="DB-Jabba the Hutt's Palace">{{DB|location|jabbathehuttspalace|Jabba the Hutt's Palace}}</ref> During his time on Tatooine, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] lived in a [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|hut]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] that was also located near the southwestern edge of the sea.<ref name="DB-Ben Kenobi's hut">{{DB|location|benkenobishome|Ben Kenobi's hut}}</ref> The Dune Sea was home to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that lived in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="sarlaccDB" />

Following the escape of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] from their clutches, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] conducted a search of the entire planet.<ref name="SWE4" /> During their search in the Dune Sea, they [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|discovered]] a small cell of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and wiped them out, as well as a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] camp nearby.<ref name="BFI">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], [[Tahiri Veila]] and [[Anakin Solo]] survived its harshest deserts, a krayt dragon, and a sarlacc, and exercised their growing [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers.<ref name="JJK:P">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Promises]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The real-world locations for the Dune Sea are the [[Grand Dune]] in [[Tunisia]] and [[Yuma]] Desert in California.

It is believed to be inspired by [[Wikipedia:Frank Herbert|Frank Herbert's]] planet [[Wikipedia:Arrakis|Arrakis]] from the [[Wikipedia:Dune (franchise)|''Dune'' series]].

The Dune Sea appears in a map in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''. During the Historical Campaign, the battle on the map appears as an Imperial mission, although the game's story was [[Canon|secondary continuity]] according to [[Leland Chee]], the keeper of [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|56|starwars.com forum HolocronKeeper comments archive}}</ref>
